meta_description:
7,665 likes, 45 comments - drmarkhyman on October 31, 2026: "This goes for kids and adults 😉

Halloween is one of my favorite nights of the year. The costumes, the neighborhoods, the kids running around with pure joy — there is something really special about it.

But here is what I know after 30 years of medicine: sugar on an empty stomach hits completely differently than sugar after a real meal.

Eating protein, vegetables and healthy fat before the candy reduces blood sugar spikes by up to 37%. That means less of a crash, less of a meltdown, less of a sleepless night, and more enjoyment of the actual candy because your body is not in chaos trying to handle it.

So tonight, before you head out — scrambled eggs, a piece of salmon, some roasted veggies, whatever you have. Then go have the best Halloween.

You and your kids deserve both.".
